definitions.explanation: To press and fold dough or similar substances repeatedly to make them smooth and pliable.
To make petty complaints or arguments (often in the form {理屈|りくつ}を{捏|こ}ねる).

examples.japanese: ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねる。
⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{捏|こ}ねて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Knead the clay well before shaping it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{捏|こ}ねて⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Knead the flour and water well to make the dough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屁理屈|へりくつ}→屁理屈：15530_herikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねないで。
⟦{理屈|りくつ}→理屈：02513_rikutsu⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧{捏|こ}ねて⟦いないで→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦なさい→なさい：09856_nasai⟧。
examples.english: Stop nitpicking and just get on with it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{理屈|りくつ}→理屈：02513_rikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねて⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He always nitpicks and opposes other people's opinions.

notes:
USAGE: {捏|こ}ねる is an ichidan verb used primarily in cooking and crafting contexts.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)

ASPECT: {捏|こ}ねて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing kneading action or habitual kneading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねる (to knead dough)
- ⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねる (to knead clay)
- ⟦{理屈|りくつ}→理屈：02513_rikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねる (to quibble, make excuses)
- ⟦{屁理屈|へりくつ}→屁理屈：15530_herikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捏|こ}ねる (to nitpick, make sophistic arguments)

KANJI NOTE: The kanji {捏|こ}ねる uses a relatively uncommon character. Often written in hiragana as こねる in casual contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ - to knead, to train, to refine
- ⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧ - to mix
